thread:
alex: Quick follow-up to the postmortem I just posted — link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/kv-eviction-2026. TL;DR: recurring KV cache evictions during short bursty traffic cause tail latency spikes and model fallback. Need concrete test additions + owners so we don't regress.

maya: Saw it, thanks. Can we break this into (1) regression promptset, (2) load test profile that reproduces bursts, (3) chaos drill (KV eviction), and (4) alerting/SLI gating? :thumbsup:

sam: I can take (1) + (2). For the regression promptset I want to capture 3 modes: short chat, long convo with KV reliance, and embedding-heavy batch. Will add ~40 prompts to `regress/kv-eviction-promptset` and link to eval harness.

toni: I'll take (3) chaos drill and own the runbook. Proposing monthly small-scale drill + quarterly full blast. Also will add a synthetic that forcibly clears KV entries to simulate eviction.

priya: I'll own (4) alerting and the canary gating around fallback models. Idea: add a gating test that fails if fallback rate > 1% for 5m. Also add a cost/latency dashboard tile.

alex: Nice. Let's state owners + deadlines here so it's actionable. I'll paste a compact action list.

alex: ACTIONS:
- sam: add regression promptset `regress/kv-eviction-promptset` and create an eval job `evals/kv-eviction-regress` (due 2026-04-07) :calendar:
- sam: add load profile `load/kv-burst-200-10m` and k6 script + CI job (due 2026-04-07)
- toni: author chaos drill runbook `runbooks/kv-eviction-drill.md` and schedule pilot (due 2026-04-10)
- priya: add fallback-rate SLOs, dashboard, and a canary gating check in the deploy pipeline (due 2026-04-05)
- maya: add these to the postmortem checklist and ensure follow-ups are in the postmortem board (due 2026-04-03)

sam: Confirming dates. For the load script I'm going to start with `k6` and a short dev run:

```bash
k6 run load-kv-eviction.js --vus 200 --duration 10m --out json=./artifacts/kv-burst-200-10m.json
```

sam: The script will exercise both short and long sequences and emulate KV pressure by hitting the prefix/cache keys frequently.

toni: Drill plan sketch:
- pilot in staging with maintenance window
- step 1: enable KV eviction sim (5m)
- step 2: run load profile from sam
- step 3: observe routing/fallback behavior and latency
- rollback plan: automatic disable eviction + revert routing if fallback > 3%

priya: For gating I propose adding a unit in the deploy pipeline:
- run `evals/kv-eviction-regress` post-deploy for 10m
- fail deploy if fallback_count / total_calls > 0.01
- mark as manual override only if oncall approves

alex: Small note on metrics: please ensure `model_fallback.v1.count` and `kv.eviction.rate` are both instrumented and added to the dashboard. We need per-model breakdown (hosted/dedicated/private) so we can correlate.

maya: I'll update the postmortem doc and the board. Sam/Toni/Priya — can you drop PR links in this thread when done? I want tracker -> postmortem -> PRs in one place.

sam: Will do. Draft PR for promptset coming tonight. Will include eval config:

```json
{"name":"kv-eviction-regress","promptset":"regress/kv-eviction-promptset","retries":3,"metrics":["latency_p95","fallback_rate"]}
```

tonI: (typo) toni: noted. Scheduling pilot for 2026-04-09 18:00 UTC — pinging eng-oncall then.

deploy-bot: Note: staging cluster maintenance window reserved 2026-04-09 18:00-19:00 UTC. Add who: @toni @sam @eng-oncall.

priya: Quick ask — can we also add a lightweight synthetic that runs every 5m against a canary model and asserts embedding similarity > 0.8 when KV hits expected keys? That will surface degradations early.

sam: Good idea. I can add a synthetic job `synthetics/kv-canary-embed` (5m cadence) to the CI.

alex: Great. Final acceptance criteria for this follow-up set:
1) regression eval exists and runs in CI (pass/fail defined)
2) load profile reproducible in staging and part of drill
3) chaos drill runbook + pilot executed
4) gating in deploy pipeline prevents fallback regressions >1%
5) dashboards and alerts added

alex: If all owners ack, I'll move these actions into the postmortem board and add the follow-up milestone. Please ack with :white_check_mark: and PR links here.

maya: :white_check_mark:

sam: :white_check_mark: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rls-evals/pull/482

toni: :white_check_mark: Runbook PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/211

priya: :white_check_mark: Dashboard PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/1337

alex: Thanks everyone. We'll recheck in next Tuesday's postmortem sweep. Closing thread after PRs merged. :rocket:
